attributes.name: Weapon of Awe
attributes.powers: Display this card next to a character's deck. While displayed, when that character plays a weapon on a combat check, add 3 to the check. At the end of your turn, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, you may attempt a Divine 8 check. If you succeed, recharge it; if you fail, discard it.
